rankings.good: Bryce Young and Shough are putting up real QB points (88 and 81) and JT is still a top 5 back. AJ Brown is eligible to come off IR in week 6. The bones are there.
rankings.bad: 0-3, 2nd lowest scoring, and the next three are Tony, Nfatboy and D. AJ Brown's high ankle has him on IR, Goedert sprained his MCL and is out a few weeks, Alec Pierce is on IR with his heel, and Jacobs is still on the exempt list looking at a 4 to 6 game suspension. 7 RBs and no healthy WR1. Has to trade RBs for receivers this week.

rankings.good: Puka's hip is better and he's expected back this week, McBride is a cheat code at TE, and Geno's been a solid fill in. Two of the three losses were close.
rankings.bad: Achane tore his ACL, season over. Etienne's hamstring has him out and the coach says he'll miss time, Caleb has a grade 2 hamstring and is 3 to 4 weeks out, and Rachaad White hurt his shoulder. Next three are Big Sham, Seeberger and Tony, three of the top four scoring teams.

rankings.good: Hurts and Chase is a real 1-2, and Kyren put up 21.8 in the flex. When Maye's right, this lineup can score with anyone.
rankings.bad: Lowest scoring team in the league at 105 a game. Maye went negative with no injury, he's just bad right now, Dowdle's toe has him ruled out again and Spears is nursing an ankle. One of the two hardest remaining schedules and 1 waiver move all year. Needs a QB today.

rankings.good: CeeDee and Watson are a top WR duo, Bowers is back from the knee and Jeremiyah Love is starting to look like a first rounder. Daniels is already practicing in a brace and might play in London this week.
rankings.bad: Dart's done for the year after knee surgery and Daniels dislocated that elbow for the 3rd time in a year, so even when he's back it's one hit away. Until then it's Mariota and Penix in superflex, which loses the QB matchup most weeks.

rankings.good: 3rd in scoring at 157 a game, so 1-2 is pure bad luck. Stafford, Cousins and Herbert is three QBs, and CMC's missed practice Wednesday was a rest day, not an injury.
rankings.bad: DeVonta's hamstring is acting up again and Coker has a quad strain. Bigger problem: the week 8 bye takes CMC, Olave and Kittle at the same time. Plan for it now or that's a free L.

rankings.good: Bijan is a weekly 25 and 11 yards off the NFL rushing lead. Nabers is fully cleared from the shoulder scare and Kelce is still Kelce. Lot of depth to trade from.
rankings.bad: Baker dislocated his throwing thumb and is out at least 3 weeks, so Deshaun Watson is the QB2. He also has Tyreek Hill on his roster, who isn't on an NFL team. 2-1 but 7th in scoring at 127 a game. The record is better than the team.

rankings.good: 4th in scoring at 153 a game and Gibbs is the best player in fantasy. Dak, Burrow and Darnold means a QB injury doesn't sink him, and Gibbs, London and Burrow finally all hit in the same week.
rankings.bad: Nobody at WR is fully healthy. Zay's hamstring is still coming back, Evans hurt his ribs and didn't practice Wednesday, DJ Moore is playing through a shoulder. Parker Washington is somehow the WR1 in points. Needs one real WR.

rankings.good: Allen is the best floor in fantasy, he's 2nd in scoring at 161 a game and he's got the easiest remaining schedule in the league. Henry, Swift and Javonte means he's never short a running back. That's a playoff team.
rankings.bad: WRs are a 33 year old Davante and McConkey, who's practicing limited with a foot injury. Adonai Mitchell has two splinted fingers. Trade Swift for a real WR now while he still has value.

rankings.good: Purdy, Lamar and Malik Willis. Three startable QBs in superflex is the most valuable thing you can have once byes and injuries hit. K9 leads the NFL in rushing.
rankings.bad: 3-0 but only 5th in scoring at 139 a game. JJ sprained his ankle in the 1st quarter Sunday and is day to day, Breece has a quad injury and is expected to miss week 4, Lamar's got a back thing and Terrance Ferguson's ankle is sprained. The record is about to meet the roster.

rankings.good: Goff, Mahomes and Stroud in a superflex league is the cheat code. A QB goes down and he doesn't even notice. JSN has 103.5 points, 28 more than any other WR in the league.
rankings.bad: WR2 is the hole. Nico's been out two weeks with a hamstring and is only back to limited practice, Godwin just popped up with an ankle and Jonah Coleman is on IR with a high ankle. Should flip some of that QB depth for a real WR2 before the deadline.
